subject.title: fix(ai): bound openai-chatgpt-responses WebSocket with handshakeTimeout and maxPayload

question: Must this transport reject oversized WebSocket messages before runtime buffering, or is a byte-accurate application check after event delivery an acceptable resource-exhaustion boundary across Node, Bun, and browser-compatible constructors?
rationale: The portable WebSocket interface does not expose a uniform pre-buffer payload limit, so implementation alone cannot decide what memory-safety guarantee OpenClaw intends to promise.

options.title: Require transport enforcement
options.body: Require runtime-level frame or message caps where supported, retain the parser check as defense in depth, and prove the behavior across supported constructors.

options.title: Accept parser-level enforcement
options.body: Explicitly accept that the 16 MiB check limits decoding and JSON processing rather than peak receive memory, and narrow the PR claims and proof accordingly.

recommendation.title: Require transport enforcement
recommendation.body: Require runtime-level frame or message caps where supported, retain the parser check as defense in depth, and prove the behavior across supported constructors.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history introduced the affected Responses WebSocket lifecycle and makes them the best available owner for its cross-runtime resource contract.
